notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.localOnlyNote: Reminder preferences are stored on this device only — the backend contract doesn't yet expose account-wide notification settings.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.documentsNote: Documents you upload are stored on your own backend instance, in a private, per-user folder. They are never sent anywhere else.
privacy.aiNote: AI requests are sent only to the AI provider configured on your backend (mock or OpenAI). The mock provider never sends your data anywhere.
privacy.accountNote: Your account data is scoped strictly to you — no other user can read or modify it.

ai.title: AI
ai.providerNote: The active AI provider is controlled by your backend's configuration and is shown next to every AI response.
ai.mockDescription: The mock provider generates conservative, template-based suggestions locally on the backend and never contacts an external AI service.
ai.disclaimerNote: Every AI response is labeled with its provider and a disclaimer — it's guidance, not verified official information.
